//: THE PROVINCES OF A WORLD (docs/PROVINCES.md). The owner, 2026-11-20: 'there are three regions on each planet and then the planet overall. The governor of the planet ... also controls one of those regions. And then the other two regions are controlled by different houses. So one region would be something like helium three production. One region would be military focused, and one region having another resource of some kind. This breakup won't be the same for every planet.' A home world has three provinces. The first is the SEAT and is always the house's that holds the world. The other two each have a FOCUS chosen for that world (a deposit the system carries first, then what suits its kind of world, the march on a fortress or a key of the lanes) and a HOLDER, a house, for life. `yield` is a year's and goes to the holder, multiplied by the province's level (1 to 3; `improveCost` times the level it leaves, as far as the system's development allows: the levels in works.json `upgradeAt`). `defense` is added to the system's. `title` is how the province is named, {0} the world. A holder is removed only by the one over it (`demand`): the holder of the world over a province, the leader over the world's holder over the governorship. `demand.influence` and `demand.influenceWorld` are what asking costs; `demand.yieldsAt` is how many times stronger in fleets the one who asks must be, in hundredths, before a rival house steps down rather than fights; `demand.legitimacy` is what stepping down from a world costs the house that does; `demand.answerYears` is how long a demand made of the player waits before silence is taken for defiance. SLOTS: a province other than the seat has building slots of its own (`slots.base`, one more at each development level in `slots.development` and each title rank of its holder in `slots.rank`, never more than `slots.max`); its holder builds the ordinary buildings of the world's kind in them, and what they yield is the holder's. OWES: a house that holds a province under another pays the holder of the world `owes.tithe` a year for each level of the province, and `owes.levy` as well in any year the holder of the world is at war; and it leans the holder's way in the Senate. The holder of the world sets the dues of each province: forgiven (nothing is paid, and the house leans its way the more), customary, or heavy (twice, and the house no longer leans its way). In a war of the holder of the world each paying province also sends a levy squadron of `owes.squadron` hulls a level, which sails under that house until the peace. A house may WITHHOLD its dues: it pays nothing, sends nothing and leans nowhere, and the holder of the world may ask it to step down without spending influence. A house at war with the holder of the world pays neither. `owes.defiances` is how many times the player may vote against the house over it before that house, if it can, asks for the province. `demand.ranks` is how many rungs of title a house loses when it steps down from a world. `npc.provinceYears` and `npc.worldYears`: a rival who could makes such a demand about one year in so many.
